headline: Founder & CTO at 3Brain Technolabs | Full-Stack Web & Mobile App Development | MERN / MEAN / React / Python / React Native / Node / AWS | Digital Marketing & eCommerce Solutions | Helping Businesses Grow Online
about:
As the Founder & CTO of 3Brain Technolabs, I lead a passionate team of developers, designers, and marketers who transform business ideas into high-performing digital solutions. Our mission is simple — to help companies grow through smart technology, scalable architecture, and result-driven digital strategy.

💡 What We Do at 3Brain Technolabs
We specialize in end-to-end development and digital growth across multiple domains:
🔸 Web Development:
Building responsive, fast, and scalable applications using React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, and Python (Django, FastAPI) for startups and enterprises.
🔸 Mobile App Development:
Creating seamless, cross-platform apps with React Native, Flutter, Android, and iOS — designed for performance, usability, and growth.
🔸 Cloud & DevOps:
Deploying and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, Firebase, Supabase, and implementing CI/CD pipelines for efficiency and scalability.
🔸 Digital Marketing & SEO:
Boosting visibility through on-page/off-page SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and email campaigns that convert leads into loyal customers.
🔸 eCommerce Solutions:
Developing high-converting online stores on Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart, and other marketplaces, with integrated SEO and paid promotions.

💼 Our Approach
Every project is guided by agile methods, data-backed decisions, and a commitment to long-term partnerships. We don’t just deliver code — we deliver results that help businesses scale faster and compete globally.

🌐 Whether you’re looking to build a new product, expand your eCommerce presence, or optimize your digital reach —
let’s connect and discuss how 3Brain Technolabs can accelerate your business growth.
📩 sales@3braintechnolabs.com | 🌍 [www.3braintechnolabs.com]

about:
As an entrepreneur, I believe software isn’t just about code, it’s about creating ecosystems that empower businesses to scale.

Over the years, I’ve led Ciphernutz from an ambitious idea into a global technology partner, building SaaS products, AI-powered solutions, and automation systems that drive real impact.

I create long-term partnerships where innovation meets execution. Whether it’s helping a startup launch its MVP or enabling enterprises to embrace AI and automation, my focus is on delivering measurable value.

With a vision of “Made in India, Built for the World,” I’m driven to position Ciphernutz as a trusted partner for businesses worldwide, helping them transform ideas into impactful digital solutions.
